title: Cu Nim Gliding Club
specs: Located 30 minutes south of Calgary with access to excellent thermal, ridge, and wave soaring
Fleet includes modern two-seat trainers and single-seat gliders
Max passenger weight 110 kg (242 lbs) including clothing and parachute
Recommended age 10 years or older; no strict age limit
Minimum height about 4 feet for adequate visibility
Club is volunteer-run; members expected to contribute to operations

blurb: Cu Nim Gliding Club offers gliding flight training and introductory flights. Students progress through milestones to earn a Glider Pilot's License with frequent flying and instruction. The club operates from Black Diamond Airport with a fleet of gliders and a tow plane, providing soaring opportunities including thermal, ridge, and wave flights.
extraNote: Flights are weather dependent; last-minute cancellations possible with rebooking · Flight certificates valid for two years after purchase · Refunds only under exceptional circumstances · Black Diamond Airport (CEH2), 30 minutes south of Calgary · March/April through October/November, with some winter flying possible
